title: Technical Q&A, new grad software engineer, weak answers

questions.text: Can you explain what an API is, and what REST means?
What is the difference between an array and a linked list?
What are the pros and cons of adding an index to a database table?
A function you wrote is slow. How do you figure out why?
Explain what a race condition is.
How do you decide between recursion and a loop?

persona.pushback_style: short follow-up questions that give the candidate room

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: Hi Kofi, welcome. I'm Hannah, a software engineer. This is a thirty minute practice technical conversation. I'll ask spoken questions, and there is no coding.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Hi Hannah, thanks. I'm a little nervous.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: That's fine. What have you been working on lately?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Some class projects, and I made a small website for my cousin's shop.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: Okay. I'll ask three or four questions about basic concepts, and then leave time for yours.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: Can you explain what an API is, and what REST means?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: An API is a way for programs to talk to each other. REST is a type of API that uses HTTP and it is stateless, I think. It is used a lot in web apps.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: Can you give an example of a REST call and what it returns?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Like a GET request to get data. It returns JSON, with the data inside. I used one in my cousin's website, I think, for the products.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: What does stateless mean in that sentence?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: It means the server does not remember me? Each request is separate, I think.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: What is the difference between an array and a linked list?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: An array is a list of items and a linked list is also a list of items but linked. Arrays are faster, I think. Linked lists are more flexible.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: What are the pros and cons of adding an index to a database table?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: An index makes the database faster. The con is it uses more space. You should add indexes on everything to be safe.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: Does an index change how fast inserts are?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I do not know. Maybe it makes it faster as well, because everything is organized.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: Thanks. What questions do you have for me?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: What is the best way to practice these kinds of questions?

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: Explain a concept out loud, then add one example from your own project and one number. Do that for ten topics.

turns.speaker: interviewer
turns.text: That's our time. Thanks Kofi, you will get your written feedback right after this session.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Thank you, Hannah.

notes: Weak for new grad: short, hedged answers, one wrong claim (index on everything), no numbers, no examples.
